entries.rule: track order: a track opens with untested (rule 6); seq orders ties by list position
entries.note: Grand 2021 abstract quote verbatim; icenticaftor oral, untested opener right. But it ties efficacy 3 (2021) on the same track and sits after it, so seq (year, then list order) makes this opener the latest; list it before efficacy 3.
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 6: a track opens with untested; this icenticaftor opener ties efficacy 3 (2021) and must be listed before it, so efficacy 3 (retro) is the latest and no untested_reason applies.

missing: Prospective organoid-guided patient-level track with member drug dirocaftor: HIT-CF CHOICES, NCT06468527 (acronym CHOICES; sponsor Kors van der Ent; phase 2b placebo-controlled crossover; 41 adults selected from the HIT-CF Organoid Study; primary ppFEV1; completed 2025-06-26; no results posted). Results reported only in HIT-CF/CF Europe press material (https://www.cf-europe.eu/hit-cf-choices-cftr-modulator-trial/: lung function changes from -12% to +22% ppFEV1 'along with matching improvements in sweat chloride') and FirstWord (https://firstwordpharma.com/story/6326317: 'clinical effect proportional to in-vitro' organoid response). Tier 5 patient side, trial_unreported true; the model side (HIT-CF organoid screen) needs a tier 1-3 source not located within budget. The draft's judgement cites the wrong NCT: NCT03500263 is Proteostasis's own safety study, not CHOICES. This prospective entry on cf-intestinal-organoid-fis would precede the Kroes 2026 retrodiction.

GLPG1837 on the HBE track before SAPHIRA1: Gees et al. 2018, Front Pharmacol, doi 10.3389/fphar.2018.01221 (open access, 2018-10-26): 'The observed activities in YFP halide assays translated well to primary cells derived from CF lungs when measured using Trans-epithelial clamp circuit (TECC).' Patient-derived primary airway cells with a member drug, so cf-hbe-ussing carries a GLPG1837 prediction (engagement, paired with Davies 2019) that the draft places only on the recombinant-assay track; it also settles the draft's open question that Van der Plas 2018 was a recombinant YFP assay.

Checked and not missing: navocaftor (NCT03969888 results 2023-06-28; monotherapy ppFEV1 -2.2 vs -2.2 placebo, sweat chloride -8.9 vs -2.1 confirmed) has no admissible model source on Europe PMC; ORIGIN-1 organoid-guided N-of-1 trial (doi 10.1186/s13063-026-09789-y) tests ETI only, outside the member list.
rule_questions: One trial, two genotype arms predicted by the same assay: icenticaftor met the LCI2.5 primary in class III/IV but showed 'no significant efficacy' in F508del homozygotes although the model potentiated F508del CFTR (Grand 2021). Is the track same with source_calls_it partial, contra (a wrong prediction beats a right one on the same track), or untested for that arm because the model tested recombinant F508del potentiation, not F508del epithelia as monotherapy?

Does a label whose section 12.1 (HBE) and section 14 (sweat chloride, ppFEV1) carry the two sides in separate sections count as comparison_stated and set the year under rule 6, or only a document that puts them side by side? The draft dates efficacy 4 by the 2024 label and engagement 4 by the 2025 paper for the same trial.

A model prediction of 'greater activity' than the comparator regimens (HBE Ussing) answered by a non-inferiority primary endpoint with superiority only on a secondary (sweat chloride): is that same direction_only or source_calls_it over_predicted? Rules define over_predicted only as a source call.

A prospective, member-drug, patient-level comparison known only from a consortium press release (CHOICES) whose model side is an unpublished organoid study: with no tier 1-3 model_src available, is the entry inadmissible, untested with the release noted, or tier 5 with model_src_tier null?
Tracks whose model_first_use_year precedes their first entry (FRT 2012, organoids 2016) pass lint; should the opening untested entry be mandatory per track rather than per cell?
